items.title: Labarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2021
items.q: You know Joe wrote a book on Bill Evans that’s coming out in September, his time with Bill Evans.

ctx.x: Okay. Anything that you’d like to add that I haven’t asked about?

Well I know that the family history, some of it is in Joe’s book. You know Joe wrote a book on Bill Evans that’s coming out in September, his time with Bill Evans. And I heard you talk to Pat about education. And if there’s an education gene then we must have it because our paternal grandfather, excuse me, he was able to finish three grades of school before he got indentured to a baron. And it was really rough work and he died prematurely because of it. He would play with the baron’s children after church on…
And that dated back to Sicily, that story you started?
